summary: Scope: deterministic implementation-acceptance evidence for one explicit execution-plans/<target>; no code approval, commit, release, deploy, or model launch. Require frozen baseline, candidate custody/manifests, implementation contract or compact VDD bundle, typed run request, action DAG, command registry, knowledge context, and ready Skill-input receipt. Prefer commit candidate; dirty/proposed candidates require frozen snapshot. Never infer baseline, scope, paths, commands, actions, or revisions. Use canonical Locator and hash-bound contexts; catalog_stale is degraded but non-blocking, other knowledge failures require repair route. Persist append-only binding-derived runs; never overwrite stale predecessors or auto-migrate legacy artifact-only runs. Execute prepare-run, deterministic evidence actions, receipt replay, and finalize-deterministic-run; deterministic_only avoids Bootstrap. Required semantic routes need repository-owned inspect-lineage, prepare-bootstrap, exact reviewScope across seven classes, typed route, and explicit high-cost/user reentry acknowledgement. Bootstrap exact reuse requires finalized v3, clean status, current bindings/profile/policy/authority, and immediate lineage predecessor. Repair requires Quick Dev handoff, audit-repair-completeness, complete closure, controlled receipts, targeted tests, and bounded focused/full review rules; three rounds lead manual_pause, never Round 4. Manual-pause closure requires protocol review or authorized composite, exact finding mappings, explicit acknowledgement, and finalize-manual-pause-closure. P2 findings close deterministically; P0/P1 require repair. Maintenance mode ai-native-single-maintainer; external/multi-maintainer findings are downgraded. Model routing is deterministic no-launch except policy-owned complex-recovery triggers.
